Plot DTW-based phase-distribution similarity heatmap

Source: R/plot_dtw_heatmap.R
plot_dtw_heatmap.Rd

This function plots a ComplexHeatmap heatmap from a scRhythmDTWSimilarity object returned by run_dtw_similarity(). Rows and columns represent celltype-by-group combinations. Heatmap values represent DTW-based similarity or distance between circular cell-phase distributions.

Usage

plot_dtw_heatmap(
  dtw_res,
  matrix_type = c("similarity", "distance"),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  group_colors = NULL,
  celltype_colors = NULL,
  heatmap_colors = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  width = grid::unit(9, "cm"),
  height = grid::unit(9, "cm")
)

Arguments

dtw_res

A scRhythmDTWSimilarity object returned by run_dtw_similarity().

matrix_type

A character value specifying which matrix to plot. Must be one of "similarity" or "distance". Defaults to "similarity".

cluster_rows

A logical value indicating whether rows should be clustered. Defaults to TRUE.

cluster_columns

A logical value indicating whether columns should be clustered. Defaults to TRUE.

show_row_names

A logical value indicating whether row names should be shown. Defaults to TRUE.

show_column_names

A logical value indicating whether column names should be shown. Defaults to FALSE.

group_colors

A named character vector specifying colors for groups. If NULL, the default scRhythmBayes group palette is used. Defaults to NULL.

celltype_colors

A named character vector specifying colors for cell types. If NULL, the default scRhythmBayes discrete palette is used. Defaults to NULL.

heatmap_colors

A character vector specifying heatmap colors. If NULL, the default scRhythmBayes DTW heatmap palette is used. Defaults to NULL.

title

A character vector specifying the heatmap title. If NULL, a default title is used. Defaults to NULL.

width

A unit object specifying heatmap body width. Defaults to grid::unit(9, "cm").

height

A unit object specifying heatmap body height. Defaults to grid::unit(9, "cm").

Value

An object of class scRhythmDTWHeatmap, containing:

heatmap

A ComplexHeatmap object.

matrix

The plotted DTW similarity or distance matrix.

annotation

Annotation data used for row and column annotations.

matrix_type

The matrix type used for plotting.

palette

Color palettes used for groups, cell types, and heatmap values.

params

Plotting parameters.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

dtw_res <- run_dtw_similarity(
  res_phase = res_phase,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  celltype_by = "celltype",
  group_by = "condition",
  min_cell = 10,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

ht_dtw <- plot_dtw_heatmap(dtw_res = dtw_res)

ht_dtw
plot(ht_dtw)
} # }
